owners.console: A control worker installed during healthy initial bootstrap, with its own packet buffers, stack and receipt journal; lifetime independent of the PC socket
owners.sdSupervisor: Continues rendering, input and app transitions during network loss
owners.host: Retains the same session and local RPC endpoint; fences new mutations until authenticated receipt reconciliation

identity.session: Fresh random 128-bit process/session identity; survives route changes, never reused after reboot
identity.pairing: Per-session private key, challenge-response and signed packet headers
identity.sd: May store discovery hints and trigger state; never treat a saved native address as proof of a live process

commitOrder: Host persists immutable request and sequence before transmission
Console accepts a complete authenticated packet with the expected sequence
Console records executing before invoking the SDK
Console caches the complete result before sending a response
Host persists the result before admitting the next command

lossCases.notExecuted: Resend only after authenticated receipt proves the previous committed sequence
lossCases.completed: Fetch the cached response; do not repeat the operation
lossCases.stillExecuting: Wait; do not retry the SDK call
lossCases.differentProcessOrHash: Refuse native commands; request fresh bootstrap only for a real process restart

network.consoleListener: Keep a healthy wildcard listener across adapter changes; recreate a failed listener with bounded retries and no overall deadline
network.hostCandidates: Enabled LAN/Wi-Fi addresses plus authenticated discovery announcements and prior verified addresses
network.manualAction: Refresh discovery and force one bounded fresh challenge/receipt probe, even if the old TCP socket is open and silent; preserve the same session and pending SDK journal
network.discovery: Signed new-address announcements and same-IP returns after a >5 second beacon gap trigger fresh authentication without waiting for the old SDK read timeout. Initial network-type identification alone keeps a healthy socket.
network.routeReplacement: Only one probe is active. It sends no SDK command; the old peer is retained until authentication succeeds. The serialized drive loop then reconciles the receipt, retrieves cached results or waits for executing commands without re-execution.

discoveryWake.storage: Resident unsigned 32-bit counter; included repeatedly in signed beacons, no SD write required
discoveryWake.retry: The host retains a wake or post-gap request across failed probes; later signed announcements retry it until a fresh route authenticates. Unknown discovery feature bits are rejected.
discoveryWake.action: SD application iz-reconnect (Restore connection); Plus is not bound because the user reports it causes disconnects
discoveryWake.application: Native ABI 1 entry writes the shared-header request once. Supervisor increments the resident counter and the application returns after 60 frames. No PC callback, network operation or thread is owned by the module.

ui.sdModule: Bundled SD application iz-reconnect; native startup installs it when recovery is enabled and a menu slot is available. Service lifetime belongs to the resident worker.
